svg.title: The primordial spectrum and precision across scales
svg.desc: Paper Figure 3 with both full scientific panels retained. Upper: weighted primordial fluctuation strength and one-sigma bin errors. Lower: the same relative uncertainties expressed as percentages on a logarithmic axis. Gray and gold are current constraints; orange and blue are SO-like and CMB-HD-like forecasts. Higher wavenumber means smaller cosmic scales. Precision depends on binning and forecast assumptions.

g.text: PAPER FIGURE 3 · THE SPECTRUM ACROSS SCALES
and the reach of future surveys
Solid line: Planck power-law best fit
Larger cosmic scales ← → Smaller cosmic scales
Original bin amplitudes and ±1σ errors preserved.
Precision depends on binning and forecast assumptions.
Adapted from Cheslog et al. (2026), Figure 3 · CC BY 4.0
